classification: Independent read-only source review before hosted transport probe and sixteen trials

source_review.conditions: Identical model/reasoning/runtime/common developer and user guidance; MCP registration is the condition-specific configuration.
source_review.schedule: Four authored tasks, two conditions, two repetitions; each task reverses order, four baseline-first and four MCP-first pairs.
source_review.task_integrity: Fresh pinned Git archive; checker/helper/reference patch/original upstream test hashes verified; no preparation patch.
source_review.runtime_integrity: Native CLI executable, complete installed Python package versions, runtime modules, requirements, pyproject and protocol frozen and verified before each trial.
source_review.test_integrity: Original tracked tests and test configuration restored in evaluator-only candidate copies; candidate edits remain in the agent artifacts; exact pytest counts required.
source_review.diagnostic_gate: Exact registered search arguments and source response matched to independent HTTP receipt and snapshots, followed by exact controlled loopback script execution; no model-guard calls/file changes; fixture bytes unchanged; completion and usage required.
source_review.usage: Completed-turn provider input plus output only; cache/reasoning subcategories retained, missing fields nullable, per-model-call usage explicitly unavailable.
source_review.timing: Event-reception start/completion intervals labeled as observations; service setup, shutdown and grading separately recorded; no fabricated provider phase timing.
source_review.retention: All declared trial outcomes retained, no automatic retries/resume, public reasoning items excluded, raw hashes retained.

limitations: Source/config review and no delegation attempt do not establish absence of every alpha-CLI tool. Actual diagnostic receipt gate must be reviewed after execution.
Evaluator file separation and original-test restoration are evaluation practices, not an adversarial security boundary.
The improved workflow combines guidance, text-only output, common history caps, isolation and compatible dependencies; comparison does not isolate each change.
